description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales

Are delighted to present to you for sale this charming two-bedroom bungalow residence, situated on a delightful site featuring outbuildings and an adjoining orchard, just 15 minutes from Tuam town and less than 45 minutes from Galway City.

The home sits on a generous site extending to over half an acre in area and features an extended patio area, a large garage and a separate steel shed.

On arrival, you are greeted by a charming entrance featuring mature planting and a central pathway leading to entrance. The home has been well maintained and upgraded throughout and also benefits from an extension to the rear.

Inside, the entrance hall leads to a light-filled living room featuring a fireplace with an inset stove. To your left are two generous double bedrooms.

To the rear of the house is a large open-plan kitchen, dining and lounge area, featuring a solid wood kitchen, built-in appliances and a feature fireplace with a solid fuel stove.

A good-sized family bathroom and a large utility room complete the accommodation. Glazed patio doors from the utility room lead to the extended patio area, which enjoys uninterrupted views of the countryside beyond.

There is also a mature orchard included on the plot.

This exceptionally well-located bungalow offers the ideal combination of a charming country residence close to Tuam town and within striking distance of Galway City. For the right purchaser, it offers outstanding value for money along with an idyllic country setting.

If you are looking for a charming residence that is move-in ready, sitting on a delightful site with an abundance of outside space, we are certain that this exceptional bungalow will exceed your expectations.

If this sounds like you, we would be delighted to hear from you and assist you in any way we can.

Brought to you by Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Partners for Residential Property Sales.
